name: codestats
description: Cached GitHub, WakaTime, Codex, OpenRouter and Anthropic API profile cards for Node.js and Cloudflare Workers.

GITHUB_USERNAME.description: Replace the template username with your own GitHub username. For private statistics, GITHUB_TOKEN must belong to this account.

WAKATIME_USERNAME.description: Replace the template username with your WakaTime username. Public statistics need no token; leave empty if unused.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Optional. Your GitHub PAT/OAuth token with repo, read:user and read:org for full owner/private statistics. Leave empty for public-only data.

WAKATIME_TOKEN.description: Optional WakaTime OAuth read token for owner-verified fallback. Leave empty for public statistics; heartbeat ingestion API keys do not grant statistics access.

CODEX_SYNC_TOKEN.description: Normally leave empty. After deploying, run npm run sync:codex locally to generate/install this secret and send numeric usage aggregates. A Codex login token does not belong here.

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Optional OpenRouter Management key for account usage. An ordinary inference key is insufficient. Leave empty if unused.

ANTHROPIC_ADMIN_KEY.description: Optional Anthropic organization Admin key for Claude API usage, not a Claude Pro/Max subscription. Leave empty if unused.

GITHUB_VISIBILITY.description: Use all with an owner token for public/private coverage; public limits the repository inventory to public data.

GITHUB_REPOSITORY_AFFILIATIONS.description: Repository inventory scope. OWNER,COLLABORATOR,ORGANIZATION_MEMBER includes accessible owned, collaborative and organization repositories.

GITHUB_INCLUDE_FORKS.description: Include owned/accessible forks in repository and language inventories. Stars remain limited to owned repositories.

GITHUB_INCLUDE_OWN_CONTRIBUTIONS.description: Include your own repositories in contributed-repository statistics.

DEFAULT_RANGE.description: WakaTime range only: all_time is the default. GitHub and AI providers keep their own reporting periods.

FRESH_SECONDS.description: Snapshot freshness in seconds. 21600 means six hours; older successful data remains available after upstream failures.

RETRY_SECONDS.description: Failed upstream retry delay in seconds. 900 means fifteen minutes; a longer upstream rate-limit delay takes precedence.

SNAPSHOTS.description: Persistent last-successful statistics cache. Cloudflare provisions the SQLite Durable Object automatically.
